court: In the High Court of Madras†
case_number: CRP No. 1264 of 2026 and CMP. No. 6159 of 2026
prayer: Prayer: Civil Revision Petition filed under Article 227 of Constitution of India, praying to set aside the fair and decretal order dated 9-12-2025 made in I.A. No. 2 of 2024 in I.A. No. 580 of 2021 in O.S. No. 196 of 2021 on the file of the District Munsif Court, Dharapuram
judgment_text:
ORDER

The revision petitioner, who is the plaintiff, filed I.A. No. 2 of 2024 in I.A. No. 580 of 2021 in O.S. No. 196 of 2021 on the file of the District Munsif Court, Dharapuram, seeking appointment of an Advocate Commissioner. Except one respondent, all other respondents raised objections.

2. After considering the submissions on both sides, the learned trial Judge dismissed the application stating that subdivision had already been effected and, based on the revenue records, the plaintiff is entitled to prove his case. Accordingly, the application was dismissed. Aggrieved by the same, the present revision has been filed.

3. The learned counsel for the revision petitioner submitted that in the suit the plaintiff has sought the relief of mandatory injunction for removal of encroachment. Earlier, a Commissioner had already filed a report in I.A. No. 580 of 2021, but the Commissioner filed the report only based on the revenue records without properly measuring the property. Therefore, the plaintiff filed I.A. No. 2 of 2024 in I.A. No. 580 of 2021 seeking re-inspection with a direction to measure the property with the help of a surveyor. The learned counsel further submitted that though the Commissioner measured the property, he failed to measure the alleged encroachment in the survey numbers as claimed in the rough plan.

4. On perusal of the Commissioner's report annexed in the typed set, it is seen that the Commissioner has submitted a report regarding the measurement of the property in S. No. 258/9. From the report along with the survey plan, it is clear that the property was measured and the plan was also filed to that effect. Therefore, the observation of the trial court is sufficient. The report already filed by the Commissioner along with the surveyor is proper and does not require any interference. The findings of the trial court are confirmed.

5. Accordingly, the Civil Revision Petition is dismissed. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed. No costs.
